name: side-bend-stability-ball-with-weight-plate
title: Side Bend: Stability Ball with Weight Plate
primer: This exercise uses a Stability Ball instead of a bench to work the obliques.
steps: Lie on one side of your torso with your waist and hip against a Stability Ball, and position your feet on the floor (or against a wall) for support.
With one hand, hold a weight against the side of your head.
Place your free hand across your chest to steady yourself.
Raise your torso up off the ball by flexing your waist.
With controlled movements lower yourself back onto the ball.
tips: The Stability Ball conforms better to your body and allows for correct anatomical range of movement.
